WITH matched_scans AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref, si.riskeval, sc.pressratio
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
), grouped AS (
  SELECT zoneref, riskeval, AVG(pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio,
         COUNT(*) AS scan_count
  FROM matched_scans
  GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval
)
SELECT zoneref AS site_code, riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status,
       avg_compression_ratio, scan_count,
       1.0 * scan_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched_scans) AS scan_share
FROM grouped
ORDER BY scan_share DESC
LIMIT 10;
